units: Ḥull. 109ᵇ טָחוֹ בכותל presses it against the wall (to make the milk flow out).—Part. pass. טוּחַ squeezed in.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 38:36">Job XXXVIII, 36</cite>) <he>אלו הכליות שהן טוּחוֹת וכ׳</he> that means the kidneys which are wedged into the body.

<cite ref="Berakhot 34b:28">Ber. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>אלמלי ה׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="N00340"><he>הניח</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if Ben. Z. (myself) had squeezed his head between his (the son’s) knees (praying for his recovery).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:4">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>התחיל מֵטִיחַ וכ׳</he> he knocked his head against the wall; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 30:2">Yalk. ib. 30</cite> <he>להָטִיחַ</he>. Ohol. XVII, 2 <he>ה׳ בסלע</he> struck (with the plough) against a rock.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 28b">B. Kam. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ צלוחיתו וכ׳</he> he struck (with) his bottle against the stone; Y. ib. III, 3ᶜ top, v. <cite ref="E00315"><he>הֲטָחָה</he></cite>.—Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 <he>כיון שהֵטִיחוּ פניהם וכ׳</he> when they had squeezed their faces from all sides (had in vain tried in all directions).

senses.gloss: to press the bow-string, to shoot; (euphem.) to emit semen virile.
